name: Qixi
fix_description: Add balance check in _basicTransfer: require(balanceOf[sender] >= value) before subtracting. The contract uses Solidity 0.4.25 without SafeMath, allowing integer underflow when transferring more than the sender balance.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-pair flash-swap style PoC with essentially one meaningful exploit action in the callback: transferring a huge amount of the vulnerable token to the pair to abuse broken token/pair logic. It requires minimal protocol understanding, no complex routing or multi-contract state reasoning, and an experienced auditor could reproduce it quickly.
